episodes.title: The Cult That Hunted People in Oregon
episodes.description:
00:00 - Intro
01:51 - A Town of Seventy-Five
07:41 - Salsa
12:46 - The Warning
15:53 - The Hit List
20:25 - What He Knew

In 1984, members of a commune in rural Oregon contaminated salad bars in The Dalles with Salmonella, sickening 751 people in an attempt to influence a county election. A year later, the leadership fractured, and investigators found the lab, the wiretaps, and a list of names.

If you like true crime that stays close to the evidence, subscribe for more case files like this one.
